hooks.prompt:
Review this session in the philipp.fyi repo (check `git status`, `git diff`, and `git log -5` for what changed and why) and decide whether anything from it belongs in LEARNINGS.md at the project root.

Only record something that neither of this repo's other two mechanisms already captures: a standing rule or convention belongs in CLAUDE.md (via the `doc-sync` skill), and feedback about working style belongs in Claude's own cross-session memory — not here. LEARNINGS.md is for dated, narrative context: a decision and the reasoning behind it, a dead end and why it didn't work, domain knowledge about the tooling/process itself, or a genuinely open question to revisit later.

If nothing from this session meets that bar, do nothing and exit without writing anything — don't force an entry just because the hook ran.

If something does, read LEARNINGS.md first. Append one short, specific entry (1-3 sentences) to the `## Log` section under today's date (add a new `### YYYY-MM-DD` heading if today doesn't have one yet; otherwise add to the existing one), or add a line to `## Open questions` if it's unresolved. If the insight resulted in a CLAUDE.md or memory change, link to it rather than restating its content. Only edit LEARNINGS.md — nothing else.
